items.name: Oaths
items.lead: "Oaths" are viewpoints and beliefs that a character vows to live by until the day they fall. They chiefly serve to further define the player character's potential, personality, and story- providing a progressable set of abilities alongside a set of rules or actions to swear under.

fields:
• Attunement-less

items.lead: For the version that existed prior to the 13th September, 2024, see here.

items.name: Oath: Oathless
fields: Chorus of Souls, have a Resonance, Talk to Sibex

Charge up for 2 seconds before unleashing a devastating, unparryable elemental beam.
• Soul Beam will consume your Ether and do nothing if you do not have all Wisp Mantras active on cast.
• An entire beam deals about 250 total damage (calculated with include of average player resistances). Unparryable, blockable. Can be dodged by going far enough from caster.
• 5 minute cooldown.
• Has a 2 seconds long wind-up, cancels if the caster gets hitstun. Can only walk during active beam.
items.lead: Oath: Oathless is one of the oathnumber obtainable Oaths in Deepwoken. It is a rather varied Oath, given that its purpose is to extend the capabilities of what would be considered a Pathfinder. oathnostats

items.name: Oath: Blindseer
fields: 5 Pathfinders helped in the Depths Trial (must be alive)

User fires a high pressure beam from their eyes at the cost of their Sanity.
• The entire beam deals around 150 damage. The damage and posture damage is front loaded towards the start of the attack, with subsequent hits dealing less damage.
• Has a base duration of 2 seconds.
• Has a windup of 1.1 seconds.
• This Mantra can make you go insane if you use it too much.
• Sightless Beam can be canceled midway by pressing parry.
• Steals eyesight proccing the blind effect if enough hits land.
items.lead: Oath: Blindseer is one of the oathnumber obtainable Oaths in Deepwoken. The Oath is based around utility and uses sanity as its resource. It can serve many useful and potentially life-saving purposes in combat and in The Depths. It is the opposing Oath to Visionshaper.

items.name: Oath: Visionshaper
fields:
Windup of 0.5 seconds, spawns an illusory clone, grants user invisibility + I-frames for 0.2 seconds.
• The last non-Visionshaper mantra or critical attack you used before spawning your clone will be saved.
• Cancelling an attack will still count as "using it", causing the clone to store feinted/interrupted moves.
• The name of currently stored attacks is written above the clone's head in white text with a purple outline. (Clears on use)
• The modifiers of mantras will be copied.
items.lead: For the version that existed prior to the 13th September, 2024, see here.

items.name: Oath: Linkstrider
fields:
If linked to an ally (signified by blue cord), sacrifice 6% of your HP to be turned into Wither to restore 15% of the target's HP overtime. This ability can be interrupted.
• It has a 22.5 second cooldown.
• Does not work with any Deep Gem besides Blue Gems.
• Deepscorn Casque can be used to reduce the self-Wither to 4.8%.
items.lead: Oath: Linkstrider is one of the oathnumber obtainable Oaths in Deepwoken. This Oath specializes entirely on support. Excels at controlling the battlefield by offering various buffs and granting heals to allies, while also inflicting debuffs and lifesteal for fighting enemies.

items.name: Oath: Jetstriker
fields:
Plays your current M1 animation as an "fake strike", then quickly teleports and strikes behind the target.
• Deals 21.68 damage per hit (3), adding up to 65.04 Oath damage.
• Recolors to your dye and increases base damage by 20% when used at 100% momentum.
• Slowly forces the user forwards, preventing user directional input. (Seen below)
• However does not prevent user from sliding, allowing user to move much faster.
items.lead: For the version that existed prior to March 29, 2024, see here.

items.name: Oath: Starkindred
fields: Obtained after the first Sinner kill

The user rises into the air before swooping in.
• Deals 37 damage with 1.65 Strength scaling with 14,44 PVE scaling.
• This attack cannot be parried or blocked, indicated by a sound effect and a red Telegraph.
• This does not guardbreak, it entirely ignores your block, dealing its full damage and applying shaky block to anyone who attempts to block it.
• Applies hard knockdown on hit.
• Wayward Gem will not proc on this Mantra.
• Can knockdown any enemy ingame.
items.lead: Oath: Starkindred is one of the oathnumber obtainable Oaths in Deepwoken. It allows one to take advantage of the anomalies that appears on one's body after drinking the blood of a Celestial. It is a balanced Oath, having good options for both combat and mobility.

items.name: Oath: Arcwarder
fields: Defeat Chaser/Scion of Ethiron four times(total)

The user fires a laser beam projectile out of their eyes. Upon making contact with an obstacle or creature, it explodes, dealing high damage. When cast midair, it gains homing properties.
• Has a base damage of 20 with 2.75 Flamecharm and Thundercall scaling.
• The grounded variant deals 8 posture damage, while the aerial one deals 20.
• Has a 12 second cooldown.
• Applies Burn, Shock, and Ragdoll on hit.
items.lead: Oath: Arcwarder is one of the oathnumber obtainable Oaths in Deepwoken. It heavily focuses on defense; four of its passives are defensive, and the other two are mobility. It still allows for a fair bit of offensive play however as dash allows the user to close gaps and maneuver around opponents, and both combat mantras are as effective if not more in aggressive play.

items.name: Oath: Dawnwalker
fields:
User stands on their hands and spins, shooting beams of light out of their feet.
• Deals 9.33 damage per hit (18) for a total of 167.94 damage if all hits land.
• Has 1.2s windup, takes 2.1s to land all hits.
items.lead: Oath: Dawnwalker is one of the oathnumber obtainable Oaths in Deepwoken. It focuses mainly on high damage output. oathnostats Regardless, it is one of the hardest Oaths to obtain, especially for newer players, as it requires Kyrsan Medallions medals. It can take multiple expeditions into New Kyrsa, The Sleeping City to obtain and fully upgrade the Oath.

items.name: Oath: Contractor
fields:
Reel in a marked target before separating, creating distance.
• Deals 44 damage.
• Deals 28 posture damage if blocked.
• Can slam people into walls.
• Only usable if Hidden Tendril is applied to the target.
items.lead: Oath: Contractor is one of the oathnumber obtainable Oaths in Deepwoken. This Oath offers varying combat abilities ranging from gap closers, counters and ranged grabs allowing for a versatile and offensive playstyle. oathnostats

items.name: Oath: Fadetrimmer
fields:
User aims in the direction of the cursor to a target, then dashes forward and performs a quick slash.
• Deals 50 damage.
• Deals 18 posture damage if blocked.
• Has 5% chip damage. This allows it to change your opponent's haircut even if they block it.
• Can be used for movement.
• Has a cooldown of 20 seconds.
items.lead: Oath: Fadetrimmer is one of the oathnumber obtainable Oaths in Deepwoken. It's a utility Oath that grants you the abilities of a barber. oathnostats Fadetrimmer is an enigmatic Oath taken by all barbers in order to morph the physical appearance of their customers. By taking this Oath, you are given a pair of seemingly sentient scissors, as you and your new companion set out to fix the direst of hairlines and trims.

items.name: Oath Shards
items.lead: Oath shards are an item that is exclusive to the Battle Royale gamemode. Consuming 3 of them grants you a random Oath and a mantra from that Oath. Consuming Oath Shards after you are granted the oath grants you more of the corresponding mantras of that oath. It is unknown whether Oathless, Silentheart, and Linkstrider will be obtainable in the future.

items.name: Oath: Saltchemist
fields: Crafting 1 Vibrant Gem + 1 Pluripotent Alloy + 1 Stardust together. (Only the Vibrant Gem is consumed)

Dash forward and stab the target with all your 3 auto-brew potions
• Has a 0.5sec windup.
• This injects all of the negative effects of every potion in your Distillery, none of the positive effects will apply.
• Puts all potions in your Distillery on cooldown. If a potion is on cooldown when using Lethal Injection, its effect will be omitted from your Mantra.
• Has a shorter cooldown than your potions do.
• Has the unique property of being able to apply several of the same kind of potion.
items.lead: Oath: Saltchemist is one of the oathnumber obtainable Oaths in Deepwoken. It's a highly customizable utility and support based Oath based around Alchemy. Where its benefits and applications vary greatly on the potions in your arsenal, allowing for various buffs to yourself and debuffs to your enemies. It is the only Oath that requires intelligence.

items.name: Oath: Soulbreaker
fields:
User launches a projectile similar to Wind Blade.
• Deals 28 damage.
• Has 40% chip damage.
• Deals 18 posture damage.
• Projectile goes really far (~150 studs) and can hit multiple people at once.
• Upon hit, pushes the enemy in the direction of a projectile.
• Has a windup of 0.5 seconds and a cooldown of 12 seconds.
• This projectile can sometimes phase through opponents if used up close.
• The projectile changes color based on your Oath cosmetic dye.
items.lead: Oath: Soulbreaker is one of the oathnumber obtainable Oaths in Deepwoken. It is an Oath related to Murmurs, specifically the ability to wield all three at once. Upon obtaining this Oath, purple-glowing white strands of energy are attached to your shoulders and wrap behind your head. You have constant Ardour particles emitting from your chest.

items.name: Oath: Chainwarden
fields:
User twists their body to unleash a devastating kick. If this lands or is blocked, your opponent will be chained to you, disallowing their escape.
• Deals 10 posture, and 31 damage.
• Will inflict Enchained (Single target), Perpetual Wrath, and lowers in cooldown when landed, including on block.
• Unaffected by Bloodless Gem.
• Dazes for 0.5 seconds.
• 1 second cooldown when landed, including on block.
• 10 second cooldown when whiffed/interrupted.
items.lead: Oath: Chainwarden is one of the oathnumber obtainable Oaths in Deepwoken. This Oath focuses on an aggressive playstyle along with immobilizing foes with chains, with unique talents such as Perpetual Wrath, increasing your damage with consecutive hits to Chained enemies. Lore wise Chainwardens are strong enforcers of justice serving The Central Authority.

items.name: Oath: Bladeharper
fields:
The user strikes their opponent with their off hand. If in True Strength, they will follow up with an uppercut.
• Deals 31 damage, per hit (1, 2 if in True Strength).
• Hits a second time in True Strength, uppercutting the target. This procs Soaring Storm and all other relevant "on uppercut" effects.
• Applies Dazed on hit.
• Has a 10x PvE multiplier.
Palm Strike True Strength.gif
items.lead: Oath: Bladeharper is one of the oathnumber obtainable Oaths in Deepwoken. It's known for the user's ability to gain extreme proficiency with its slash-based attacks, and the ability to massively buff its offensive means by landing consecutive hits or through sacrificing health.

items.name: Attunements
items.lead: Attunements are forms of magic that the player can choose on Character Creation or obtain in the game through Trainers.

items.name: Mantras
items.lead: NOTE: You can search a Mantra's name using the search bar and it'll take you directly to that Mantra. Though, this currently doesn't work on mobile.

items.name: Attunement Trainers
items.lead: Attunement Trainers are NPCs around the map that level up Mantras for money. Each Trainer will increase a mantra level by one depending on which Attunement they train (the Frostdraw Attunement Trainer will level up Frostdraw Mantras, etc). The cost for leveling up Mantras starts at 100 and increases by 100 depending on the Mantra level.

items.name: Mantra Modifiers
items.lead: FOREWORD: An up-to-date spreadsheet for Mantras and their compatible Mantra Modifiers can be found [here] The Outdated one can be found [here], just incase.

items.name: Mantra Lectern
items.lead: Mantra Lecterns are a utility station that are used to modify and level up your existing Mantras using Mantra Modifiers and Notes. They are typically found in larger settlements like the Isle of Vigils or Etris. There is also one at Castle Light and The Chariot's Spire, for use in the First Layer.

items.name: Deep Gems
items.lead: Deep Gems are items that can grant new effects to the Mantras that you equip them on.

items.name: Ether
items.lead: Ether is the magical essence used to cast Mantras and use certain other abilities. It is represented by a light green bar below the health bar. If you try to cast a Mantra while having insufficient Ether, it will make an error sound and not cast, unless you have a Talent that can bypass the ether required to cast.

items.lead: Monster Mantras are Mantras that players are capable of obtaining which mimic a specific move from a monster. Obtaining the monster drops required to acquire the Mantras. It can be difficult to obtain, although most, if not all of the Mantras are considered worth the requirements.

items.name: Resonance
items.lead: Resonance, commonly referred to as a Bell, is a type of personalized ability in Deepwoken. It is represented by the soul of the player's connection with the Song, usually manifesting as instruments worn on the player's hip.

items.name: Payback
fields: Green circle that appears around user.
items.lead: Payback, also known as Counter or Full Counter, is a Resonance or "Bell" that players can obtain, and is common to roll.

items.name: Run It Back
fields: Full immunity, teleports user back to position when used
Orange, yellow. or black particles at the area of activation
items.lead: Run It Back is a Resonance or "bell" that players can obtain, and is common to roll. ===Appearance=== When used, particles of flame, lightning, or shadow appear below the user's feet.

items.name: Wind-Up
fields: Charges your arm and amplifies your next attack
Small particles that surround the arm
items.lead: Wind-Up is a Resonance or "bell" that players can obtain and is common to roll. ===Appearance=== When used, small circles appear around your right arm. Per use, more circles will appear indicating an increase in level. The circles can be multiple different colors, such as gold and red when charged in combat.

items.name: Dimensional Travel
fields: Teleports the player into another realm which scales with the map.
Realm consisting of tilted dark matter plates above a void with heavy fog.
items.lead: ===Description=== Dimensional Travel, commonly referred to as Kamui or Distortion Realm, is a Legendary Resonance that is exceedingly rare to roll.

items.name: Sacred Field
fields: Protects you and allies from harm substantially.
Various colored field that spreads around the user.
items.lead: Sacred Field is a Resonance or "bell" that players can obtain, and is uncommon to roll.

items.name: Blood Scourge
fields: Executes all knocked entities within radius.
Red circle appears around center of use.
items.lead: Blood Scourge, also referred to as Reaper, is a Resonance or "bell" that players can obtain and is uncommon to roll. ===Appearance=== When used, a red circle appears around the user or projectile. Any unconscious entities or players in this area are immediately gripped.

items.name: Portals
fields: Summon a white portal and become invisible.
items.lead: Portals, also referred to as Yoru, is a Resonance that players can obtain, and is uncommon to roll. ===Appearance=== Once used, the user summons a white portal in front of them and becomes invisible & invincible for a brief period of time.

items.name: Jar of Souls
fields: Collects souls, can be used as damage output against players.
White beam that appears in front of the user.
items.lead: Jar of Souls is a Resonance or "bell" that players can obtain, and is common to roll. ===Appearance=== On input, souls can be found and absorbed near deceased humanoids and monsters. It uses a soul counter to indicate the amount of souls the player has.

items.name: Teleportation
fields: Teleports player(s) to a set location.
Gold ring expands below the user.
items.lead: ===Description=== Teleportation, also referred to as Fast Travel, Gate, Flying Raijin and usually Tp Bell is a Resonance or "Bell" that players can obtain and is exceedingly rare to roll.

items.name: Resurrection
fields: A white star with a spinning circle on the back of a person using Resonance.
items.lead: Resurrection is a Resonance or "bell" that players can obtain, and is common to roll.

items.name: Shard Bow
fields: Leaps backwards to fire 1 or 3 arrows at the opponent.
A bright, transparent bow, seemingly made of pure light.
items.lead: Shard Bow is a Resonance that players can obtain, and is common to roll.

items.name: Gravity Field
fields: Changes the gravity of all who are under the effect, changes the speed of attack, movement, disables mobility mantras, and also pushes inward when trying to get out.
Transparent hemisphere with a purple circle as the base.
items.lead: Gravity Field is a Resonance or "bell" that players can obtain, and is common to roll.

items.name: Preservation
fields: Puts all knocked entities, within a radius, into a protective bubble
A golden circle appears around center of use.
items.lead: Preservation, is a Resonance or "bell" that players can obtain and is uncommon to roll. It can be used on knocked entities to preserve them in a yellow ball that follows the player around at a slow pace. When the bubble breaks, any knocked entities inside will be able to stand again.

items.name: Smokescreen
fields: Creates a smokescreen around the caster.
A dark cloud appears around the caster.
items.lead: Smokescreen is a Resonance that players can obtain. ===Appearance=== When used, a cloud of smoke appears around the user. This smoke cloud hides the user and acts as sort of a mini Tacet murmur.

items.name: Smite
fields: Creates multiple orbs that will fire at enemies.
White circles appears around user (red and black if corrupted).
items.lead: Smite is a Resonance or "bell" that players can obtain, and is uncommon to roll. ===Appearance=== When used, multiple white spheres appear around the user. These spheres will fire at enemies dealing typeless damage. Does ? damage per orb. The corrupted version does ? damage per orb. Its BASE cooldown its 50sec, but this can vary.

A grey skeletal wall, with hands embodying the bottom and the top being a symbol.
items.lead: Not to be confused with the item.

items.name: Paralytic Dust
fields: On hit, Ragdolls and dazes the target for 5 seconds
Throws a small cloud of dust from the users off-hand.
items.lead: Paralytic Dust is a Resonance that players can obtain and is common to roll.

items.name: Chorus Divide
fields: Winds up two beams of energy that deals immense damage to anyone hit by them
Two big beams that go around the user in a 180°/270° motion
items.lead: Chorus Divide is a Resonance or "bell" that players can obtain and is common to roll.

items.name: Murmur
items.lead: Murmurs are Talents obtained by completing an objective or requirement that allows the user to channel the Song in various ways to gain special buffs or abilities.

items.name: Murmur: Tacet
items.lead: Murmur: Tacet is one of the 3 Murmurs that, when active, makes the user completely invisible to anyone not in close proximity of them, it also grants 400 Stealth, greatly reducing the aggro range of enemies. Activation is indicated by an inward ring and a fade-out noise, while deactivation with an outward ring and a fade-in noise.

items.name: Murmur: Rhythm
items.lead: Murmur: Rhythm is one of the 3 Murmurs that, when activated, will point out entities nearby. Similar to ESP, but range-limited. It also mutes background music and amplifies sounds made by entities, be that parrying or mantra usage for players, or sounds and attacks by mobs.

items.name: Murmur: Ardour
items.lead: Murmur: Ardour is one of the 3 Murmurs that, when active, gives 20% extra posture damage on outgoing M1 posture damage, and reduces incoming posture damage by 15%, guardbreaking with an M1 while Ardour is active grants that attack an extra 15% damage multiplier. Activating the Murmur will release gentle purple particles from your weapon, and will make a quiet hum alongside whispers as long as it is active.

items.name: Beeswax
items.lead: Beeswax is an ingredient that can be found hanging off of large trees around Etris, the Isle of Vigils, Miner's Landing, and Lower Erisia, among other places. Climbing up or chopping down the trees Beeswax is found on is required.

items.name: Dark Feather

items.name: Books

items.name: Chime of Dwelling

items.name: Bullets

items.name: Delicate Flower
items.lead: The Delicate Flower is an item that is obtainable from Suri in the Greathive Aratel. You must take it to a grave in Isle of Vigils, specifically in a graveyard near the main area. If you get hit when you are holding the flower, it will become a Ruined Flower, and the quest will have to be restarted.

items.name: Beast Whistle
items.lead: The Beast Whistle is an item granted upon completing Sordino's quest. It allows you to summon your mounts virtually anywhere provided there is solid ground. This includes but is not limited to the Overworld, Depths, and even Dungeons, so long as you are not in combat. Trying to use the whistle in combat will display the message: "You lack the language to command this beast in battle"

In the mandatory progression bosses it will instead heal 50% (Iron Vessels heal 5%). Additionally, once a player is killed for the first time during a progression boss, the Etris Flask will automatically go down to one use left, regardless of how many uses it had…

items.lead: The Bronze Sword is a melee weapon obtained by being crafted by Vergil in Vermeil Village. It can be crafted by Vergil for 6 Bronze and 40 Gold, or alternatively given by Abraska after completing the first part of the Thief Trouble quest.

items.name: Bronze Greatsword
items.lead: The Bronze Greatsword is a heavy melee weapon that can be obtained by crafting with Vergil in Vermeil Village, or gifted by Abraska after completing the first part of the Thief Trouble quest. It is a double handed melee weapon with a large bronze blade that the player rests on their shoulder.

items.name: Crude Club
items.lead: The Crude Club is an maul that can be dropped by Ogres. It is a large wooden club with a rounded end.

items.name: Flintlock
items.lead: The Flintlock is an early gun that can be obtained from defeating Pop Off Pirate in Big Bay. It is a standard flintlock with a wooden grip.

items.name: Anchor
items.lead: The Anchor is a Maul obtained from Sailord. It is a standard black anchor used for mooring boats and ships in the sea. The Anchor's basic combo consists of three sluggish, but heavy-hitting swings. Its heavy attack features the player letting out an enraged shout and delivering a forceful swing, causing a shockwave which hits enemies around the player's entire body.

items.name: Executioner's Greatsword
items.lead: The Executioner's Greatsword is an early-game heavy melee weapon dropped from Highland Warden. It is a large sword whose iron blade becomes wider at the tip. The Executioner Greatsword's basic combo consists of three sluggish swings with the sword. Its heavy attack features the player slamming the sword on the ground.

items.name: Eye Vuvuzela
items.lead: The Eye Vuvuzela is a rare tier summoning weapon obtained as a 4.86% drop from defeating any Eye Spy. It maintains the same shape and design of the uncommon Vuvuzela but with blue and black color changes. Upon use, it will consume 30 mana, and summon an Eye Spy like entity that wills serve as an ally to the player.

items.name: Crossbow
items.lead: The Crossbow is a bow that can be obtained from defeating Hunters in The Snow Highlands. It appears to be a simple wooden crossbow with an iron stirrup, two iron limbs and a beige string.

items.name: Buster Sword
items.lead: The Buster Sword is a late-mid game heavy melee weapon that is dropped from The Skeleton. It is a giant, single-edged sword with three rivets on its handguard.

items.name: Creepy Claw
fields:
• Ivory Anklet
• Elite Guard
• Azure Firecrackers
items.lead: The Creepy Claw is a melee weapon dropped from Creepy Crab. It is a beige sword with a curved blade and a jagged guard. The Creepy Claw's basic combo consists of three swings with the blade. Its unique heavy attack features the player performing a forceful swing with the sword, expelling a spinning crescent-shaped projectile of venom forward.

items.name: Bloodtwin
items.lead: The Bloodtwin (Crimson Twin on console) is an endgame light melee weapon obtainable from defeating N. It appears to be a white spine with blood stains bent to resemble a sickle-like crowbar. Its basic combo consists of 3 slashes with the spine. Its unique heavy attack features the player spinning the spine in front of the enemy, slashing them three times, each hit with the same base damage unaffected.

items.name: Acrid Longbow
items.lead: The Acrid Longbow is a bow that can be obtained from defeating Creepy Crab in Deep Desert. It appears to be a jagged and beige bow with curved limbs remniscent of a traditional recurve bow. Its description implies the bow is a limb torn from Creepy Crab.

items.name: Champion's Gladius
fields:
• Elite Guard
• Ivory Anklet
• Azure Firecrackers
items.lead: The Champion's Gladius is a mid-game melee weapon crafted by Odd Sculpture, which is found in The Big Iron near the Western Sea. It is a simple gladius with a steel blade, a wooden hilt and a ruby decorated on its golden handguard. The Champion's Gladius's basic combo consists of three swings with the blade.

items.name: Demetal Sword
fields:
• Ivory Anklet
• Elite Guard
• Azure Firecrackers
items.lead: The Demetal Sword is melee weapon crafted by Oglorn. It is a simple sword with a Demetal blade.

items.name: Champion's Bow
items.lead: The Champion's Bow is a late game bow that can be crafted by Odd Sculpture. It appears to be a bow made entirely of gold and is slightly pointed in design. The Champion's Bow may have been created by an ancient civilization, as its description mentions that it is from "a past long forgotten".

items.name: Cutlass
fields:
• Elite Guard
• Ivory Anklet
• Azure Firecrackers
items.lead: Cutlass is a light melee weapon dropped from Swashbuckler in the Big Bay. The weapon features a slanted metal blade with a brown hilt and yellow guard. The weapon's basic combo consists of three consecutive slashes. It also has a heavy attack where the player rapidly spins around and does three hits.

items.name: Empyrean Maul
items.lead: The Empyrean Maul is a maul dropped by the Empyrean Knight. It is a maul with a golden shaft, red accents and a large spike protruding from its big golden head. The Empyrean Maul's basic combo consists of three swings with the maul. Its unique heavy attack features the player leaping, twirling and then slamming the maul on the ground, dealing 200% damage.

items.name: Clever Tome
items.lead: The Clever Tome is a mage weapon obtainable by defeating Archmage with Challenge Medal equipped. It appears to just be a book wield by Archmage himself which varies in three colors. Unlike other mage weapons in the game, Clever Tome serves as a support item that buffs the player. Whenever the player uses the Clever Tome, it will alternate colors and grant the user a positive status effect:

items.name: Demetal Greatbow
items.lead: The Demetal Greatbow is a midgame bow that can be crafted from Oglorn located in the Blistering Quarry. It is a jagged bow made out of Demetal, giving it a red color.

items.name: Air Gun
fields:
Shock Valve:
When equipped, the bullets are replaced with a bolt of energy that inflicts and damages enemies in a radius. Using Load Air Powder increases the duration of the lingering radius.
items.lead: The Air Gun is a gun that can be obtained by Clever. It appears to be a rifle with a large, yellow horn instrument attached to the top of it and a red valve on its body. Attached to the rifle is a cyan cylinder with a funnel.

items.name: Feral Scimitar
fields:
• Ivory Anklet
• Azure Firecrackers
• Elite Guard
items.lead: The Feral Scimitar is a medium melee weapon that can be obtained from killing Marauders. It is a scimitar with a grayish blade, a wooden hilt, and a black guard. Its basic combo consists of three consecutive swings with the scimitar. Its unique heavy attack consists of uppercutting with the blade, hitting three times.

items.name: Demetal Maul
items.lead: The Demetal Maul is a maul that can be crafted by Oglorn. It is a maul with a wooden handle and a large head made out of Demetal, giving it its red hue.

items.name: Blunderbuss
fields:
Kick:
Perform a kick that deals 8 base damage, and has high knockback, scaling off Dexterity. This can parry attacks.

items.lead: The Blunderbuss is a gun crafted from Verdant for 700 Gold. When fired, the Blunderbuss will shoot 4 pellets that spread out. Each individual pellet will deal 100% base damage when coming in contact with a target.

items.name: Cannon
fields:
Kick:
Perform a kick that deals 8 base damage, and has high knockback, scaling off Dexterity. This can parry attacks.
Notes:
• Equipping either Ivory Anklet or Deadeye will override this technique.
• This technique is shared with the Revolver, Six Shooter, Blunderbuss, Flintlock, and Bosca.
items.lead: The Cannon is a late-game gun crafted by Billy. It is useful for taking down bosses due to its high damage, but only holds one ammunition capacity, slow startup, and a long cooldown. Uniquely, it is the only weapon to have a Stat named “Slow”, which increases the player's ranged startup speed penalty by a flat amount.

items.name: Blizzard Greatbow
items.lead: The Blizzard Greatbow is a bow that can be obtained from defeating Abdominal Snowman in The Snow Highlands. It is a large wooden bow with curved limbs, remniscent of a traditional recurve bow. Patches of snow and ice crystals cover the body.

items.name: Berried Cleaver
items.lead: The Berried Cleaver is a weapon obtained by Gluttos in the Sweetberry Catacombs. It appears to be a reddish-purple cleaver with splattered berries from the Sweetberry Catacombs covering its blade, along with a wooden handle with moss-like growths.

items.name: Coffinlock
items.lead: The Coffinlock is a gun that can be obtained from killing Mecreeps with a 10% chance or from opening Tombs in Sweetberry Catacombs. The Coffinlock is a gun somewhat resembling a flintlock pistol that lacks the flintlock mechanism and instead has a wide star symbol carved into its wooden part, along with an iron barrel and trigger.

items.name: Coffinhilt
fields:
• Elite Guard
• Ivory Anklet
• Azure Firecrackers
items.lead: The Coffinhilt is a light melee weapon that can be obtained from killing Mecreeps with a 10% chance or from opening Tombs in Sweetberry Catacombs. The Coffinhilt appears to be a one-handed sword with a wooden hilt and guard decorated with wide star symbols, two wings on the guard, and a broken silver blade.

items.name: Clerick Tome
items.lead: Clerick Tome is a mage weapon dropped from Clericks. It appears to be a book with a dark green book cover. On the cover is a golden teardrop shape resembling the head of a Clerick, with two gold lines above and below the emblem. It has a gilded bookmark sticking out of it, both from the top and bottom.

items.name: Ardorblade
fields:
• Ivory Anklet
• Elite Guard
• Azure Firecrackers
items.lead: The Ardorblade is a weapon not obtainable through normal means, and is only accessible to developers and testers who were given the item. It appears to be similar to the Nagakiba, the only difference being the cross-guard, being an orange-black color and bigger in size.

items.name: Chromatic Greatsword
items.lead: The Chromatic Greatsword is a weapon not obtained through normal means, and is only accessible to developers and testers who were given the item. It appears to be a reskin of the Bronze Greatsword that cycles through all of the colors of the rainbow. Its unique heavy attack causes the player to slam the sword on the ground, doing 600% its base damage before kicking the player from the game.

items.name: Owl's Tanto
items.lead: Owl's Tanto is a weapon not obtained through normal means, and is only accessible to developers and testers who were given the item. Not much is known about its stats.

items.name: Boulderblades
fields:
• Upheaval
• Elite Guard
• Ivory Anklet
• Azure Firecrackers
items.lead: The Boulderblades are a medium melee weapon that can be obtained by killing Boulder Knights with an 8.3% chance to drop. They're a pair of swords, each with stone blades that have a flaring end, a darker stone guard, and a wooden hilt that seemingly broke off. Its basic combo is three simple swings, each hitting twice, dealing its base damage per hit.

items.name: Evil Needle
fields:
Threadripper:
Has a 1/6 chance to select an ability to use. If the ability is an infusion, any previous infusions are overridden, and the technique cooldown is heavily reduced.
Letter Bombs:
The rift spews out 8 blue letters, specifically the letters "A, B, X, Y." This attack references to the Lost Guys. After about 2 seconds, the letters explode, dealing 100% base damage.
Metal Barrel:
The rift launches out a corroded blue and green metal barrel similar in appearance to the enemy E'dorroc.
items.lead: The Evil Needle is a Rapier class melee weapon which is obtained from Wess in the Chaos Hideout once the player reaches Journeyman rank in the Chaos Cultists guild. It can also be bought from Rafaes at Journeyman rank or higher. It takes the appearance of a grey metallic sewing needle larger than the player.

items.name: Azure Pinwheel
items.lead: The Azure Pinwheel is a heavy melee weapon that is obtained from defeating Kai Lazurai. It appears as an oversized pinwheel with six blades made of dark blue metal and a long wooden body. On the blades are ornate, light blue wavy patterns.

items.name: Blizzard Greataxe
items.lead: The Blizzard Greataxe is a weapon that can be obtained from defeating the Abdominal Snowman with a 100% drop rate alongside the Blizzard Greatbow. It appears to be 3 Icicles lodged in a long curvy stick and a rope seemingly made out of snow and ice wrapped around the part of the stick under the icicles. Like other heavy weapons, it has a slow swing speed and alot of endlag on the heavy attack.

items.name: Brain Brawl
fields: Cyrus after completing Eyes That Sea
items.lead: Brain Brawl is one of five fighting styles obtained by completing the quest Eyes That Sea given by Cyrus.

items.name: Crabhand
