items.lead: N, also known as Nr. N, is a boss in Pilgrammed that can be fought after completing the Innocuous Induction quest from Rafaes in the Sinister Sea and gaining entry to the Chaos Hideout. Little is known about this mysterious being, but it is described several times as a physical manifestation of the force of chaos. Information about its origin and the nature of its creation is shrouded in mystery.

items.name: Highway Son
fields:
• Cloud Wilds
• Elite Barracks (Post Defeat)
• Mt. St. Rhubarb

• Sun Medallion (33.3%)
• 4-8 Pure Essence (100.0%)
(Challenge Medal Special Drops)
• Highway Cloak (100.0%)
items.lead: The Highway Son is a boss enemy found within the Cloud Wilds and the last living remnant of a society lost to time. The Highway Son was born in the wake of a fallen civilization known as The Highway. The description of the Highway Cloak seems to indicate that the Highway Son is also a descendant of a prestigious lineage, perhaps indicating the reason he shares his name with The Highway itself.

items.name: Creepy Crab
fields:
• Creepy Claw or Acrid Longbow (100.0%)
• 1-3 Venom Gland (100.0%)
• Fetid Crabspawn (20.0%)
items.lead: The Creepy Crab is one of the 2 bosses of the Deep Desert and resembles a giant, rather crustaceous creature and found at the coast of the Deep Desert. The glands inside the Creepy Crab's body produces venom which it can utilize to slowly kill its prey in a rather limited variety of attacks.

items.name: Mondo Squid
fields:
• Dash Bracelet (100.0%)
• Mini Squid (33.3%)
• Kiramisu Robes (14.3%)
items.lead: The Mondo Squid is a boss that can be found scaling up the north headland of Big Bay. Mondo Squid is a gigantic squid that utilizes incendiary cannonballs to barrage its enemies alongside being able to breathe outside of water. It seems to be rather intelligent, leading a gang of squids in The Western Sea that have gained notoriety. Beating Mondo Squid is required for the last step of the Elite Training quest.

items.name: Bigfish
fields:
• Trident (100.0% first time, 20% after)
• Diver or Diver Hood(100.0%)
• Spark Scale (33.3%)
items.lead: The Bigfish is a powerful, enormous boss-type fish that swims in the Sinister Sea off the coast of Deep Desert. Bigfish is known for its shock absorbing scales, which many hunters make an attempt to hunt for, resulting in no success essentially. Bigfish also makes use of its electricity-based power to hurl electric bolts.

items.name: Golden Knight
fields: • Golden Knight Helmet (100.0% first time, 10.0% after)

• Delaware Knight (Guard)
• Ranger Knight (Guard)
• Fat Dude (Guard)
items.lead: Golden Knight was an enormous knight clad in golden armor who resided atop a tall tower in Delaware that appeared exclusively during the April Fools Event 2023. Golden Knight was the final major boss of the Saga Mode, but was quite easy to defeat despite this. Golden Knight was supposedly the leader or coordinator of the Delaware Knights that populate the area.

items.name: Mr Tokin
items.lead: Mr Tokin was the second primary Saga Mode boss in April Fools Event 2023. He was a huge sentient token that resided over and protected the World of Tokens. He was said to be the master of all tokens, and appeared to be very protective of the tokens in the token world. Upon seeing the player, he would become aggressive, assuming the player was trying to steal his coins.

items.name: Giant Pigface
items.lead: Giant Pigface is a secret boss which appears on the middle of the large borders between The Prairie, Pogo Path, Big Bay and The Suslands. Near it is a tree that exclusively drops Plums when hit alongside ruined stone structures.

items.name: Primordial Red
items.lead: Primordial Red was a boss that appeared exclusively during the April Fools Event 2023. It resided within The Crater, a secret area that could be reached by falling off the side of the Atlantean Plane I. Primordial Red was a rather unique boss, being unable to move or attack. It didn't appear to possess an organic form, instead resembling a conduit of red energy.

items.name: Crude Knight Reznor
items.lead: Crude Knight Reznor is the fourth boss featured in April Fools Event 2023. He can be found in the Ruined Solemn City, which is accessed by interacting with the egg found at the end of the main path in The Ringed City.

items.name: Neptune & Ball
items.lead: Neptune & Ball was the sixth Saga Mode boss in Pilgrammed's April Fools Event 2023, who could be found in Atlantean Plane I during the event's duration. He was a ruthless and tyrannical king who ruled over the Atlantean Plane I using his immense power. In his kill message, Neptune is described as once being a noble warrior before being corrupted by the temptations of wealth and power.

items.name: Shinobi King
fields: King of All The Shinobis and, Unbeknownst to Most, The Sole Proprietor of this Establishment!
items.lead: The Shinobi King is the first boss in Pilgrammed's April Fools Event 2023 located in Reborn World's sub-area, Shrine of Samurais, residing in the diner at the end of the island. Shinobi King is the ruler of all the shinobis, and the sole proprietor of the Shinobi Family Diner, an empty diner that seems to have gone up in flames for an unknown reason.

items.name: False Believer
fields:
• Rusty Bell (50.0%)
• Ragged (33.3%)
• Bell Saint's Mask (16.7%)
• 5-10 Pure Essence (100.0%)

• The Bellkeeper
• Stray
• The One with the Bell
• Bell Saint

• Snow Cultists (Formerly)
• Faith of the Bell (Currently)
items.lead: The False Believer, also known as the Bellkeeper, is a secret boss who resides in The Winter. He is a Snow Husk who has defected from the Snow Cultists' faith who has instead become fixated on and developed his own faith surrounding the bell, which has made him a target of the cultists.

items.name: Snow Cultist
items.lead: The Snow Cultist is a secret boss located in the Frozen Cathedral. The Snow Cultist is an acrobatic dancer much like the other snow cultists in Isle of the Recital. He wields a pair of icy bladed fans called the Snowshatters to complement his dancing skills and to use as a weapon.

items.name: That Whale
items.lead: That Whale is a boss that could be found in Atlantean Plane I during the April Fools Event 2023. They were supposedly a regular whale until they ate fish tacos, which made them grow to an immense size. They also seem to regret that decision, as reflected in their dialogue.

items.name: Stone Collector
items.lead: Stone Collector was a major boss in Saga Mode during the April Fools Event 2023. During the event's duration, he was situated at the top of the Big Techcorp Company building in the Land of de Billionaires, likely holding some high ranking position at the company. He appeared to be extravagantly wealthy, flaunting armor made entirely of as well as a refined mustache and various expensive accessories.

items.name: Ravenous Loan Shark
items.lead: Ravenous Loan Shark is the cohort boss of Stone Collector of Big Techcorp Co., in the Land of de Billionaires during the April Fools Event 2023. Ravenous Loan Shark's existence serves to reference the phrase, "loan shark", which is a person that exploits others financially through money lending. Ravenous Loan Shark seems to be so rich that they are literally made of money, in the form of $100 USD bills.

items.name: Grave Treelad
fields:
Grass (Not covered in Venom)
Venom (Covered in Venom after using the Burrow attack)
items.lead: Grave Treelad is one of the bosses in Sweetberry Catacombs that can be found at the end of the Silent Sanctuary, a sub-location of Sweetberry Catacombs. It is a larger and more powerful Treelad who, despite having been exposed to the effects of the Sweetberry Blight, remained as the garden's last guardian, as all the other Treelads in the garden had either died from the blight's influence or escaped into the Morning…

items.name: Cata
fields:
• 3-8 Gelatinous Sludge (100%)
• The Rot or Noxious Mortar (100%)
items.lead: Cata is a secret boss found in the Sweetberry Catacombs by opening the last gate in the catacombs by using a Broken Lever Piece to fix the gate's lever. Cata is described as being a warrior born from rot, and was possibly formed due to the Sweetberry Catacombs' blight, that has cursed the rest of fruitfolks, making Twigfaces, Twigwrithes and the finally Cata.

items.name: Purple Shark
items.lead: Purple Shark is a boss found in the Cobalt Caverns which very closely resembles a normal Shark. Its boss arena can be accessed after destroying two Purple Crystals. Unique to this boss, the player is able to get NPC support from Taurus if the player completes his quest before entering Purple Shark's arena and acts similar to the Elite Defenders in the Prairie or The Evil Army.

items.name: Captain Whelk
fields: Evil Leader of The City Hill Zone
items.lead: Captain Whelk is the tyrannical boss ruler of the City Hill Zone, which can be found in the Whelk Seas during the April Fools Event 2024. Captain Whelk is an immensely wealthy leader, seen in his gold clothing and his entire city being made of sparkling gold.

items.name: 50 Bandits
items.lead: 50 Bandits is a boss and character located in Vernice during the April Fools Event 2024, who is a criminal that opposes the Anti-Thieves. 50 Bandits is a powerful version of the Ruffian, a lesser bandit located on Roberto's Island. 50 Bandits has likely garnered up a Bounty from killing Anti-Thieves, causing him to be locked up in a cobalt-blue jail cell in Vernice.

items.name: Kai Lazurai
fields:
• Kai Guy (Fellow Kai)
• Kai Bai (Fellow Kai)
• Devai (Fellow Kai)

• Azure Pinwheel (100.0% first, 20.0% after)
• 12-16 Arcane Essence (100%)
• Windman's Cloak (100.0% (With challenge medal))
items.lead: Kai Lazurai is an extremely powerful boss in Pilgrammed and is the de-facto leader of the dwindling Kai Legion, a clan of warriors who derive power from their advanced wielding of Mana, from the environment around them. He resides in the Legacy of the Legion, the Kai's collective dream conjured after the defeat of Old Fart.

items.name: Psychocrab
fields:
• Braincoral Visage (100.0% first time, 20.0% after)
• 5-9 Iridescent Shard (100.0%)
items.lead: Psychocrab is a secret boss that can be found in the Cobalt Cavern. They are described as something that shouldn't be disturbed despite being told from another of its kind; Cyrus. It's unknown what caused Psychocrab to exist and how it gained magical powers, but just like the Crablands and Crystalbuds in the Cobalt Cavern, they are a territorial enemy that is hostile towards the player, using a combination of…

items.name: Lost Guys
fields:
• Lost Wax (100.0%)
• 5-10 Chaos Essence (100.0%)
• 5-10 Pure Essence (100.0%)
items.lead: The Lost Guys is a boss found through going through Rifts and spawns only in the Shapeworld rift type. Lost Guys possesses two faces, one red and oval, one yellow and triangular. The Lost Guys are capable of using their immense power to send destruction towards those who dare oppose them. Despite their unassuming appearance, they are still absolutely able to kill, search, and destroy any unprepared player.

items.name: Jim
fields:
8-16 Chaos Essence (100%)
Lightless Cavalier (100% first time, 20% after)
Nos Dywyll (33.3%)
items.lead: Jim is a secret boss in Pilgrammed, introduced in version rain2. He is an inter-dimensional bounty hunter, pursuing those who have defied the natural order of the universe and traveled to worlds beyond their own. He will occasionally appear after the player clears a Rift.

items.name: Nadurtha
items.lead: Nadurtha is a major boss in the April Fools Event 2025 who dwells within Mt. The Sky's The Limit. It can accessed by talking to Rutherford at the Limit Summit. Nadurtha is a massive serpent with innate ice and energy powers, along with the ability to revive itself after death. It is as old as the formation of Mt. The Sky's The Limit, and is said to be the "true lord of the mountain" as opposed to Rutherford.

items.name: Father Sajurn
items.lead: Father Sajurn is a tall, black figure wearing a top hat. he has his arms raised and shakes violently. He will appear after Decayed Pirate Sajurn has a heart attack after hearing the player has taken all five thrones. He is the final boss of the April Fools 2025 Event.

items.name: Maynard
items.lead: Maynard is a dangerous and well-known boss and leader found in the Wo'ur Bo'uh Nuclear Bunker, being a very confident though sometimes cowardly opponent for the player to duel against to flush his throne.

items.name: Fenrir
items.lead: Fenrir is the undead king of Pan-Ettone and one of the five thronetakers in the April Fools Event 2025. He can be found as a boss encounter in the Chateau D'Sewage, a throne room inside The Royal Sewers. Before his death, Fenrir was the head of the Pan-Ettone Royal Family, the husband of Lutemis, and a friend of Dragonlord Bruto.

items.name: Brown Bear
items.lead: The Brown Bear is an uncommon enemy that dwell on the mysterious Bear Island or stroll around in the lush Forest. They are rather aggressive and faster than an average enemy, making them dangerous. Notably, they can drop both the Revolver and the Bear Clover, which can be useful items for early gun builds.

items.name: Blue Slime
items.lead: The Blue Slime is a stronger variant of the green slime and are found within the Forest. As indicated by their blue color and slightly larger size, the Blue Slime varies in difficulty from the Green Slime, having more health and dealing more damage. Although not being the strongest slime variant, they are at least more challenging to take down.

items.name: Cactus Man
items.lead: Cactus Man is an uncommon enemy found wandering the Desert of Foreboding Terror. Its existence is the result of a Thief having fused with a cactus using radioactive waste. It is now a sentient cactus creature hostile to those that would pass through the desert. They are fairly slow, but their elongated limbs can grab enemies from a distance, and their prickly bodies can inflict.

items.name: Dreadful Imp
fields:
• Volcano
• Sky Battlegrounds
• The Evil Army
items.lead: The Dreadful Imp is a magical enemy that inhabits the Volcano. These enemies are heat resistant and perfectly suited to the climate of the Volcano. They are skilled with simple magical abilities, able to cast fireballs at enemies, teleport, and even hover above the ground.

items.name: Black Slime
items.lead: Black Slimes are powerful variants of slimes that can be found within the Björn Cave and a small island in The Eastern Sea. The Black Slime is both larger and stronger than the Blue Slime, but its mobility is much slower. Able to leave slime puddles to trap and slow players, the Black Slime can be a difficult opponent for lower-level players, but its slow movement makes it easy to escape from.

items.name: Artilleryman
fields:
• Gunpowder (33.3%)
• Keen Lens (16.7%)
• Artillery Officer (14.3%)
• Durag (14.3%)
items.lead: The Artilleryman is an enemy that is guaranteed to spawn on the side of the two pirate ships out in the water. Artillerymen use the ship's cannons to fire one big shot at players. They are deadly for players who are moving slowly, however, they can easily be avoided if the player moves quickly enough.

items.name: Cannoneer
items.lead: The Cannoneer is an uncommon enemy that wanders in the Big Bay. They can be very deadly to newer players that are slow to react to the cannonballs he shoots. The weapon that they wield is the Cannon, and as confirmed by Bailiff and their bestiary description, they got their cannons from Sinister Sea, or more accurately, they bought their cannons from Billy

items.name: Bushwalker
fields:
• Snow Wanderer or Snow Wanderer Hood(16.7%)
• Icy Flute (2.5%)
items.lead: Bushwalkers are creatures that can be found wandering around The Snow Highlands. Bushwalkers are territorial and dangerous, and are stated to be "beautiful" as suggested by their Bestiary description. Despite their hostile nature, they seem to be at peace with the Hunters, another hostile force found in the highlands as evidenced by some Hunters occasionally riding on top of Bushwalkers.

items.name: Chalkman
items.lead: The Chalkman is an enemy mostly found in the Morning Hollow. As stated by its Bestiary description, there is more than one Chalkman, with them serving as literal pawns to something much larger, though unseen threat.

items.name: Copper Ant
items.lead: The Copper Ant is an enemy that can be found in The Suslands. They're insectoid automatons composed out of copper, allowing them to conduct electricity and use it to attack the player. They seem to be constructed by the Marauders, as implied by their coexistence in the Suslands.

items.name: Daedalus Drone
fields:
• Deep Desert
• The Eggroost
• Factory approach
items.lead: The Daedalus Drone is a mechanical drone that can rarely spawn in the Deep Desert and The Eggroost. They seem to be crafted with high technology that rather resembles magic.

items.name: Cultist
fields:
• N (God)
• Rafaes
• Wess
• Deimos
• Barrett
• Traitor (Enemy)
items.lead: The Cultist was an enemy that could be found in a cliff next to the Sinister Sea. They served as members of the Chaos Cultists, which worships N as their god. Four of them could be found meditating around an altar with a red sigil on top. If the player attacked one of them, the Cultist and other nearby Cultists would stop their meditation and retaliate by pursuing the player in order to kill them.

items.name: Boulder
fields:
• Strange Chasm
• Cold Cliffside
• Mountain Basin
items.lead: Boulder is an enemy very similar to the Pebble. These Boulders were presumably made from the same iridescent crystals as the Pebbles were. It is worth noting that despite the striking similarities, the Boulder and the Pebble are very far apart from each other on the map.

items.name: Blackened Skeleton
items.lead: The Blackened Skeleton is an enemy that can be spawned from The Skeleton in Blackened Cove. It appears to be a soul that has once been part of The Skeleton, being released as The Skeleton takes damage. Like other skeleton enemies, the Blackened Skeleton says "I've got a bone to pick…" when spotting a player and "MY SKULL!" when at low health.

items.name: Coral Man
items.lead: The Coral Man was an enemy that appeared within the Atlantean Plane I exclusively during the April Fools Event 2023. It appeared to be an aquatic variant of the Cactus Man enemy. The Coral Man is suggested by the Bestiary to have been the result of a mutation involving coral and radioactive waste, forming the coral into a humanoid creature.

items.name: Cruel Frog
items.lead: The Cruel Frog was an enemy that appeared in The Solemn City area during the duration of the April Fools Event 2023. They could be found lurking within the lakes of venom beneath the city. They appeared and behaved very similar to the Froglo enemies, possibly being a relative of the Froglo that adapted to dwelling within The Solemn City's poisonous waters.

items.name: Clerick
fields:
• Clerick Tome (6.7%)
• Clerick Robes or Clerick Hat (10.0%)
items.lead: The Clerick is an uncommon enemy found within Sweetberry Catacombs. They are described as "malicious interlopers who cash in on a little bit of tragedy," possibly implying that they use the Sweetberry Catacombs' blight to their advantage. Due to the fact that the Clerick is meant to represent a bishop Chess piece, it is possible that Clericks are in some way related to the Chalkman.

items.name: Archduke
items.lead: Archduke was an enemy exclusive to the April Fools Event 2023 who appeared atop the cave in the Reborn Island. There, three Archduke enemies could be found together and would attack players that attempted to approach them. The Archduke enemies boasted high amounts of HP and would attack by swinging their neon green clubs.

items.name: Delaware Knight
fields:
• Ranger Knight (Associate)
• Fat Dude (Associate)
• Golden Knight (Ruler)
items.lead: Delaware Knights are enemies that could be found patrolling on Delaware Ashen Capitol's castle grounds, as part of the April Fools Event 2023. Delaware Knights were knights appointed by the Golden Knight to defend against intruders, along with their ranged counterparts, Ranger Knights.

items.name: Auditor
fields: Wherever you want me to be.
items.lead: The Auditor is an unusual entity that will spawn in if the player kills too many enemies in a short amount of time. It has the same attacks as a regular Brown Bear, and can be parried and dodged. It serves as an anti-farmer to gold grinders. It can spawn anywhere in the map, as long as there is a player farming many enemies. It has no known description, and always spawns with the Giant trait.

items.name: Snowslug
fields: 0.25 (I assume it is cause dmgreduction 0.25 not defense.)
items.lead: The Snowslug is a scrapped enemy, and can only be spawned by developers, although it appeared in Pilgrammed for about an hour before being removed at an unknown date. It appears to be able to only spawn naturally in a specific place in The Snow Highlands when it was in game. Its primary method of attack was to lunge at players or smack them. There currently isn't much else known about the Snowslug.

items.name: Crabland
items.lead: Crabland one of the few enemies that can be encountered in Cobalt Cavern. It is a large miniboss with a sturdy shell, and patrols many passages throughout the cavern.

items.name: Choccy Bean Pebble
items.lead: The Choccy Bean Pebble is a Bestiary-excluded enemy and a variant of the Pebble from the April Fools Event 2024 found in Wondrous Factory. It is a re-colored Ore Pebble that drops Choccy Beans.

items.name: Anti-Thief
items.lead: The Anti-Thief is a common entity in the April Fools Event 2024. Their main goal is to keep everybody safe, going after criminals like 50 Bandits when they escape prison to prevent harm to Vernice and the Whelk Seas. Anti-Thieves seem to serve the role of police officers and the navy, best seen in their artillery-manning counterparts, Anti-Thief Artillery.

items.name: Anti-Thief Artillery
items.lead: Anti Thief Artilleries are the range counterpart of the Anti-Thieves. They have the exact same appearance as the Anti-Thief, however they operate a large cannon. Anti Thief Artilleries are stationary, and don't move from their original location (Needs to be fact-checked)

items.name: Mortal Manifestation
items.lead: Mortal Manifestation is a small urchin. It is very similar to Urchin, however, it is small, shoots red clouds at you, and has 50 more health. It is a very rare enemy to come across, since it can only be spawned by admin commands.

items.name: Boulder Knight
items.lead: The Boulder Knight is an enemy found in the Strange Chasm. As seen in the Bestiary, they were once golems who roamed the earth, and either lived to stay in the Strange Chasm or began disappearing for unknown reasons. They might be connected to Granny, having similar appearances and found in the same area.

items.name: Brain Coral
items.lead: Brain Corals are enemies that can be found in the Cobalt Cavern. Their main purpose is to support other enemies by healing them and stunning the player. They drop the Ego Gland (12.5%), a great support accessory, and the Smart Stem Staff (8.3%), a useful buffing/healing summoning weapon.

items.name: Crystalbud
items.lead: Crystalbuds are immobile enemies stuck to the walls and ceilings of the Cobalt Cavern. They fire crystal shards at the player that inflict Heavy bleeding. It is recommended that you use a range weapon to slay them, as it exceedingly difficult to reach them with melee weapons (despite the fact that there are some Crystalbuds you can easily hit with melee weapons).

items.name: E'dorroc
items.lead: E'dorroc is a commonly appearing enemy that is exclusive to Chemical Realm variants of the Liminal Space, which can be seen with the Melterinos and Ta'natnoc. They are highly aggressive metallic arachnids that have absorbed acid, scrap, and fire to boost their strength.

items.name: Cloaked Demon
items.lead: The Cloaked Demon is an enemy added in version rain which can be found in the Museum variant in Liminal Spaces alongside their other counterpart, the Apathy Demon, but can rarely reside in some Liminal Spaces too. They are also found when spawned by Jim, a secret boss that can be found after completing a rift, though they are less threatening to their normal counterpart.

items.name: Dune Gunner
items.lead: Dune Gunner is a enemy that appears in the Tektite rift. It appears in both variants, but it doesn't appear in any other spaces.

items.name: Dune Enforcer
items.lead: Dune Enforcer is a Tektite enemy that appears exclusively in the Tektite variant of Liminal Spaces. It holds a tektite hammer that can cause explosions. They mostly appear in the Tektite Heights variant, but they can also appear in the Tektite Valley variant too.

items.name: Apathy Demon
items.lead: The Apathy Demon is an enemy added in version rain which can be found in the Museum variant in Liminal Spaces alongside their other counterpart, the Cloaked Demon, but can rarely reside in some Liminal Spaces too. They are also found when spawned by Jim, a secret boss that can be found after completing a rift, though they are less threatening to their normal counterpart.

items.name: Baby Turtle
items.lead: The Baby Turtle is a non-hostile creature located in the Sinister Shore. It cannot be attacked or harmed, as it serves as a part of the Sinister Shore's environment. When you approach it and it spots you, it will try to escape from you, although it moves quite slowly similar to its older variant, Magma Turtle.

items.name: Gemini Eye
items.lead: The Gemini Eye is a rare enemy that can only be spawned by moderators

items.name: Brain Buddie
items.lead: Brain Buddie is a summon, Using almost any gem on the Smart Stem Staff will affect it's ranged attack. It can spawn with five different colors, those being pink, blue, green, orange and yellow. It also has a chance of being Mondo.

items.name: Candle Knight
fields:
• Red key card (first time 100%, then after that 0.0%)
• Knight's Glaive(33.3%)
• 5-9 Mimic Wax(100.0%)
items.lead: The Candle Knight is a boss located in Crono's Factory in the Junk Pits, specifically the Alchemical Sector of the Factory. The player is required to fight them to progress further into the Factory, as he drops the Red Key card.

items.name: Boomer
items.lead: Boomers are enemies that can be spawned by Democan in The Road. The Boomers are small, hostile, and essentially, "living-bombs" made out of mechanical plastic cores; formed by violence that had manifested into a physical form. It is dark gray with a tube torso, a domed head with a red eye, disjointed pieces of metal resembling arms, and a large metal rod extending from it's torso.

items.name: Creep
items.lead: Creep is a powerful enemy that spawns in the Abandoned Metro. There is only one Creep in all of Pilgrammed, found standing in the pool of blood on the way to Factory Approach. It's not very agressive and will simply stare at players it see, though, if approached too close, it will attack. Its moveset consists of a rapid flurry of claw slashes and a powerful beam of red energy that it fires while tilting upwards.

items.name: Green Slime
items.lead: The Green Slime is a common early game enemy native to The Prairie. Although appearing rather peaceful, Green Slimes are hostile and will attack the player on sight. They are one of a few different variations of slimes that can be found in Pilgrammed, with the green variant being the weakest among them. They can drop the Green Slime material used for crafting and extending the length of status potions.

items.name: Eye Spy
fields:
• Parry Manual (10.0%)
• Mana Flint (5.0%)
• Eye Vuvuzela (5.0%)
items.lead: The Eye Spy is a giant supernatural eyeball that dwells within the Temple of Foreboding Terror. Unlike other enemies, the Eye Spy is completely immobile, staying stationary and shooting small magic projectiles in the player's direction. The Eye Spy nearly invulnerable, barely taking any damage from the player's attacks. Attempts to defeat it in its normal state are mostly fruitless.

items.name: Froglo
items.lead: The Froglo is an mid-game enemy in Pilgrammed, which live in the bottom river of the Deadly Swamp. Living alongside the Wicked Witch, these frogs lash out with their tongue in attempts to defend themselves and their home against wandering travelers. They are not tough on their own, but may be problematic if they fight in swarms of two or more.

items.name: Eye Fly
items.lead: The Eye Fly is an enemy that spawns in the Cloud Wilds. It is a giant, pink eye guarding the temple in the wilds. The Eye Fly is seemingly a highly defensive enemy. However, when parried, most of it defenses are removed as it drops to the ground and become vulnerable to every attack for multiple seconds, after which it flies back up again and return to its attacking pattern.

items.name: Highland Warden
items.lead: The Highland Warden is an enemy located in The Snow Highlands. As seen by their appearance, they seem to be an Ice Troll, but giant, and hostile, due to their weapon being for an executioner, and their aggression would spread to the others due to the fact they have been stranded in what seems to be a destroyed small village, possibly defending it or destroying it, since they possess the ability to break the houses…

items.name: Tank
items.lead: Tank is a skill in the Defense category.

items.name: Bloodthirst
fields: Every melee hit you land builds up stacks of bloodthirst. At 25 stacks, go into a frenzy for 2 seconds, boosting swing speed by 50% and removing any endlag.
Bloodthirst frenzy lasts 3 seconds longer, but so does the cooldown.
items.lead: Bloodthirst is an Offense Skill that costs 4 Skill Points and 8 to Ace. While active, whenever the user gains stacks for 8 seconds whenever they hit an enemy with a melee weapon. (2.5 stacks per hit, usually), capping at 25 stacks. When the user reaches 25 stacks it activates for 3 seconds (6 if Aced) (erroneously states 2 seconds in description) which increases melee swing speed by 50% and removes endlag for all…

items.name: Tenacity
fields: You can survive one hit with 1 HP left and debuffs cleared. This can only occur every 5 minutes.
You now gain 25% increased regeneration for 5 seconds when this occurs. The cooldown is now 3 minutes.
items.lead: Tenacity is a Skill found at the uppermost section in the Defense category, requiring 4 skill points for the Base version. When equipped at base form, if the player suffers an attack that deals damage more than their current health, their Health will be left at 1 instead of dying, and any negative status effects inflicted upon them will be automatically removed.

items.name: Fearmonger
fields: Taking damage causes enemies you hit to be fearful (enemies take 10% more damage and do 10% less damage) for 5 seconds.
Fear's effects are twice as effective.
items.lead: Fearmonger is an Offense skill that costs 2 skill points. When hit, the player gets inflicted with Scary. Hitting an enemy with Scary inflicts Scared, which reduces their damage output by 10% and allows you to deal 10% more damage. Neither of these statuses can stack.

items.name: Athlete
fields: You reach max running speed 50% faster and your max running speed is increased by 10%.
Your roll cooldown is reduced by 25%.
items.lead: Athlete is a Misc skill that allows you to move faster. Its Base form allows you to reach the max running speed 50% faster and increases your max running speed by 10%.

items.name: Vexation
fields: Max health is decreased by 50%, non-natural healing reduced by 25%, but you gain 25% damage reduction.
Damage is now reduced by 50% and non-natural healing reduced by 20%.
items.lead: Vexation is a Defense Skill which makes the player have 50% less max health and regeneration, but more damage reduction. It requires 4 Skill Points for the Base version, which reduces the player's health cap by 50%, and their non-natural healing by 25%, but gives 25% damage reduction.

items.name: Juggernaut
fields: Being in combat will grant 10% damage reduction, but 10% lower speed and enemies target you.
Gain an additional 10% damage reduction and 10% increased damage during this but another 10% decrease to movement speed.
items.lead: Juggernaut is a skill in the Defense category.

items.name: Focus
fields: Being stunned will no longer stop you from rolling.
Being stunned will no longer stop you from blocking or parrying.
items.lead: Focus is a Defense Skill, with its Base version costing 2 Skill Points, and its Aced version costing 4 Skill Points. Its base version allows rolling while stunned, and its Aced version allows blocking and parrying while stunned.

items.name: Rude
fields: Grants a 4% up to 16% damage buff for every enemy within 50 studs.
Now grants a 6% up to 42% damage buff for every enemy within 75 studs.
items.lead: Rude is an Offense skill that costs 3 Skill Points. While active, the user deals 4% more damage per enemy within 50 studs, capping at 16% (4 enemies).

items.name: Perception
fields: Ineffective elemental attacks now deal full damage.
Effective elemental attacks are now +20% more effective.
items.lead: Perception is an Offense skill that costs 4 Skill Points. While active, dealing damage with an element that is ineffective against the target's element will no longer apply a 30% damage penalty.

items.name: Archery
fields: Hit a target within 1.5 seconds of fully charging your bow to boost crit chance. This bonus stacks up to 25%, but is lost if you do not hit a target on time.
This bonus now decreases charge time by up to 50% and no longer dissipates entirely upon failure.
items.lead: Archery is an Offense skill that costs 4 Skill Points. While active, hitting an enemy within 1.5 seconds of your bow fully charging gives a few stacks of Archery Prowess that boosts crit chance with bows up to +30%, despite the description saying +25%.

items.name: Rampage
fields: Killing an enemy grants you 1 stack of Rampage (6% more damage) for 10 seconds. Rampage is capped at 5 stacks.
Deal 50% more damage to enemies with less than 75% of your max health.
items.lead: Rampage is an Offense skill that costs 3 Skill Points. While active, the player gains a Rampage stack whenever they kill an enemy. The player deals 6% more damage per stack, capping at 30% with 5 stacks. All stacks are removed after 10 seconds have passed without killing an enemy.

items.name: Delicate
fields: You gain 2% crit chance for every defense point below 10, up to 20%.
You gain 1% increased crit damage for every defense point below 10, up to 15%.
items.lead: Delicate is an Offense skill that costs 4 points. While active, the user gains 2% more critical chance per Defense point below 10, capping at 20%.

items.name: Wizardry
fields: Being very close to an enemy increases mana gained by up to 25%.
The range is increased by 50% and the boost is now increased up to 40%.
items.lead: Wizardry is an Offense skill that costs 4 Skill Points. While active, being very close (actual distance is very large, even at base) to an enemy increases Mana gained by up to 25%.

items.name: Sharpshooter
fields: Standing still slowly increases your ranged weapons' ranges by up to 75% and crit chance by 10% after 1.5 seconds of not moving.
This effect now maxes out by 1 second and now increases ranged damage by up to 25%.
items.lead: Sharpshooter is an Offense skill that costs 3 Skill Points. While active, it increases the maximum range of ranged weapons by 75% and crit chance by 10% while the user is standing still for atleast 1.5 seconds.

items.name: Chicanery
fields: Your bullets shoot a weaker bullet towards another enemy when hitting an enemy or a wall.
It's now a 100% chance to shoot and it can ricochet many more times.
items.lead: Chicanery is a skill in the Offense category.

items.name: Ineffable
fields: Mana cost is reduced by 20% when above 80% mana.
Mana cost is reduced by 50% when below 20% mana.
items.lead: Ineffable is an Offense skill that costs 3 Skill Points. While active, mana cost is reduced by 20% when above 80% mana.

items.name: Rally
fields: Parrying an attack increases your mana regeneration by 25% for 3 seconds.
Parrying an attack restores 6% of HP over 2 seconds.
items.lead: Rally is a skill in the defense category. Its Base costs 2 Skill Points, giving a status effect called after parrying an attack, which increases your mana regeneration by 25% for 3 seconds. Its Aced version, costing 4 additional Skill Points, adds another effect called, which will heal 3% of your maximum health per second, over 2 seconds after parrying an attack.

items.name: Resilient
fields: Taking damage grants you a stacking 10% damage resistance up to 50% for 2 seconds.
This effect now lasts 3 seconds and you gain super armor when you take damage.
items.lead: Resilient is a skill in the defense category. Its base costs 3 Skill Points, which makes taking damage give stacks of Resilient which give 10% damage reduction, up to 5 stacks (50% damage reduction) for 2 seconds.

items.name: Alchemist
fields: You drink potions 25% faster and have a 25% chance to not consume a potion ingredient.
You now drink potions 70% faster and have a 50% chance to not consume a potion.
items.lead: Alchemist is a Misc skill that costs 4 Skill Points. It shortens the animation of drinking potions by 25%. It also has a 25% chance to not consume a potion ingredient while brewing potions, as not getting rid of that brewed potion when consuming it.

items.name: Slippery
fields: The movement speed reduction from attacking or being stunned is reduced by 35%.
Dodging an attack with a roll or dive will reset your roll cooldown.
items.lead: Slippery is a Misc skill that costs 2 Skill Points. It reduces the movement speed penalty from attacking or being stunned by 30%.

items.name: Stoic
fields: You can drink potions while you have potion sickness (as long as it's shorter than 30 seconds), but it will take much longer to drink.
items.lead: Stoic is a Misc skill that costs 3 Skill Points. It shortens potion sickness by 30%, making it pair well with the Alchemist skill.

items.name: Planning
items.lead: Planning was a Misc skill that costed 3 Skill Points. While active, players may replace anything in their loadout except Skills without requiring a Cabinet by using the View Loadout button in their inventory.

items.name: Tricky
fields: Rolling gives you Tricky Roll for 1 second that is consumed when you attack. Tricky Roll reduces gun startup time by 50% or increases melee swing speed by 20%. This has a 3 second cooldown when used with melee weapons.
Tricky Roll now reduces gun startup time by 75% or increases melee swing speed by 40% and also reduces gun cooldown by 50%. And also the melee cooldown is now 2 seconds. Whew.
items.lead: Tricky is an Offense Skill that costs 3 Skill Points. While active, whenever the user rolls. The user is inflicted with the Tricky Roll status effect for 1 second (with 3 seconds of Tricky Cooldown) that is consumed whenever the user attacks with a melee weapon or gun. Tricky Roll reduces gun startup time by 50% and increases swing speed by 20%.

items.name: Deception
fields: Dodging an attack also triggers any effects that would have occurred had you parried it instead. Yes, you can parry enemies with rolls.
Parrying an attack also triggers any effects had you dodged it instead.
items.lead: Deception is a Misc Skill that costs 4 Skill Points, added in version rain2. While equipped, dodging an attack also triggers any effects that would have occurred had you parried it instead.

items.name: Unfettered
fields: Any status effect that reduces your speed only affects you half as much as usual.
You are stunned for 30% less time.
items.lead: Unfettered is from the skill tree in the Defense category. Its Base requires 2 Skill points and cuts the amount that slowing status effects affect you by half, meanwhile the Aced version which costs 4 Skills points makes you stunned for 30% less time.

items.name: Bolster
fields: Parrying no longer stops you from blocking. In addition, as long as you are blocking you will parry one attack. This has a 4 second cooldown.
You still take some damage while blocking, but it will count as a parry.
items.lead: Bolster is a skill in the Defense category.

items.name: Magic Chalk
items.lead: The Magic Chalk Technique is located in the Morning Hollow. To get it, use the Forgotten Village mirror then head to your left and go past the waterfall. Look to your left and you will see a small opening above the water, go through and follow the glowing blue path to find the Magic Chalkman. You must have more than 30 Intellect to obtain the technique.

items.name: Occult Arts
fields:
• Dagger
• Bloodtwin
• Normal Claw
• Haunted Scythe
items.lead: Occult Arts is a very powerful Technique obtained by talking to Rafaes after getting Apprentice rank in the Chaos Cultists guild. It has two different modes, the first one being Blood, and the second one being Chaos.

items.name: Arrow Rain
fields:
• Shock Arrow
• Ice Arrow
• Explosive Arrow
• Scrap Arrow
• Fire Arrow
• Flare Arrow
• Slime Arrow
• Magma Slime Arrow
• Silver Arrow
items.lead: Arrow Rain is one of the 20 Techniques added in Version rain. Arrow Rain is compatible with Light Bows. Arrow Rain is centered around dealing more damage in a specified area.

items.name: Ivory Anklet
items.lead: Ivory Anklet is a Technique added in version rain. It is compatible with Guns, Pistols, Swords, and Rapiers. To obtain it, defeat Highway Son. Once defeated, go to the Elite Barracks and talk to him, and he will give you the technique.

items.name: Twisted Technique
items.lead: Talk to Garth in the Elite Barracks after defeating The Skeleton.

items.name: Upheaval
items.lead: The Upheaval Technique can be obtained by talking to Garth at the Elite Barracks after completing the "Elite training" questline.

items.name: Serpent Style
items.lead: The Serpent style Technique can be obtained by doing the questline Scholar of the Serpent from Boyle, who is located to the left of the Temple of Foreboding Terror.

items.name: Azure Firecrackers
fields:
• Swords
• Gun
• Fist
• Kaismith Hammer
• Azure Pinwheel
items.lead: The Azure Firecrackers can be obtained by talking to Kai Lazurai after obtaining the Apprentice rank in the Kai Legion guild. He will grant the player access to the technique afterwards.

items.name: Giantslayer
items.lead: The Giantslayer Technique can be obtained by talking to Taurus at the seaside near the Forest. He will start the Secrets of Cobalt quest, and after its completion he will grant the player the technique.

items.name: Elite Guard
fields:
• Elite Shield
• Scrap Shield
• Gel Shield
items.lead: The Elite Guard technique is given by Kyle at the Elite Knight Barracks when you reach the Master level at Elite Knights Guild, alongside the Rallying Warhorn.

items.name: Duelist's Dagger
items.lead: The Duelist's Dagger can be obtained via talking to Sir Pwnsalot while owning a rapier. He will ask the player if they would like to purchase the Duelist's Dagger for. If answered yes, the technique is bought.

items.name: Monarch Claws
items.lead: Monarch Claws is obtained by completing Boyle's last quest, found at Eggroost Observatory.

items.name: Bell Saint Style
items.lead: Bell Saint Style is one of the many Techniques added in Version rain.

items.name: Darkspin Arts
fields:
• Snowshatters
• Blizzard Greataxe
• Viking Axe
• Iron Battleaxe
• Silver Axe
items.lead: Darkspin Arts is obtained from the quest Clash of Faiths by siding with Gale. It can also be obtained from Oracle in The Winter if you sided with False Believer.

items.name: Tidal Technique
items.lead: Tidal Technique can be obtained via defeating Sailord and obtaining the Anchor, after which talking to Sailord's Brother provides the technique.

items.name: Deadeye
items.lead: Talk to Hugh at The Suslands found in the hill at the shore after defeating Shock Marauder. You must have the Sundowners to gain the technique.

items.name: Scrap Nailgun
items.lead: The Scrap Nailgun can be obtained at Apprentice rank with the Eggroost Observatory Guild. Talking to Billy will start the Questline: Of Slime and Scrap. You will need a Scrap Sickle or Scrap Longsword to start the quest.

items.name: Shock Valve
items.lead: The Shock Valve can be obtained by ranking up in the Eggroost Guild to Master, then talking to Billy.

items.name: Boom Shells
items.lead: After the player completes the Scholar of the Serpent quest from Boyle, he moves to Cloud City. He can be talked to, to start the Unconventional Weapons questline, which rewards the Boom Shells technique upon completion.

items.name: Sonic Boom
items.lead: Completing Boyle's 3rd quest, "Resonant Research", after his encounter in the Cloud City.

items.name: Bronze
items.lead: Bronze is a common material that can be obtained by crafting it from the Blacksmith, with three Bronze being crafted from 2 Copper and 1 Tin. It is a brownish-orange metal that can be used to mold some early tools and weapons.

items.name: Copper
fields:
• The Prairie
• The King's Den
• Forest
• Björn Cave
• The Suslands
• The Eggroost
items.lead: Copper is a common material that can be found from mining Ore Deposits in The Prairie, The King's Den, the Forest, the Björn Cave, The Suslands, and The Eggroost. It is a reddish brown metal that conducts electricity. It can be given to the Blacksmith to craft Bronze, used to make early tools, as well as used in various other crafting recipes.

items.name: Arrow
items.lead: Arrows are consumable items that can be purchased from Archer in Vermeil Village, with 5 Gold purchasing 20 Arrows. They can also be dropped by Raider Rangers in the Desert of Foreboding Terror. If the player has a bow, they can consume the supply of Arrows in their inventory to fire at enemies and other targets.

items.name: Apple
fields:
• The Prairie
• Pogo Path
• Legacy of the Legion
items.lead: Apples are a common fruit harvested from Trees in The Prairie, Pogo Path and Legacy of the Legion. They can also be obtained from smashing Barrels, killing Treelads, or purchased from Pomme in the Forest for 10 Gold. They are a simple red round fruit with a yellow core. They can be cooked in a Cauldron to create Appley Juice, a useful healing item early in the game.

items.name: Green Slime (Material)
items.lead: Green Slime is a common material obtained from defeating Green Slimes. It appears to be a small round mass of an opaque green substance, known as slime. Using Green Slime as a supplemental ingredient when cooking in a Cauldron will extend the length of Potions that grant Status Effects, but weakens the strength of the effect.

items.name: Blue Slime (Material)
fields: A sort of chaotic mixed bag of boosting strength and time.
items.lead: Blue Slime is a rare material obtained from killing Blue Slimes as well as defeating the Yalgaroth boss. Being a rare material, its uses are more advanced than Green Slime. When used as a supplemental ingredient when cooking potions, Blue Slime can increase both the length of the Potion as well as the potency of any Status Effect.

items.name: Iron
fields:
• Morning Hollow
• Desert of Foreboding Terror
• The Suslands
• Big Bay
• Cold Trail
• The Snow Highlands
• Deep Desert
• Deep Desert Caverns
items.lead: Iron is an uncommon material obtained from mining Ore Deposits in the Morning Hollow, Desert of Foreboding Terror, The Suslands, Big Bay, Cold Trail, The Snow Highlands, Deep Desert, and Deep Desert Caverns. It is a simple dark brown metal. Iron is useful for various things. Notably, it is able to craft several new weapons and tools from Gorlan in the Desert Outpost.

items.name: Demetal
items.lead: Demetal is a rare ore obtained from mining Ore Deposits within the Volcano, completing a fishing quest, and the Cruel Caverns. The ore's name is a portmanteau of the words "demon" and "metal." It appears to be a dark red metal that was potentially manipulated by the Volcano's hot climate.

items.name: Gems
fields:
• Enemies
• Treasure Chest
• Bag of Gems (Big Iron)
• Sky Battlegrounds
• Talvern (Exchange)
items.lead: Gems are rare items that possess the ability to add unique and powerful modifiers to weapons, with the additional perk of changing their appearance. So far, there are only eight Gems in the game, each providing its unique effects and colors. Gems can be forged onto weapons, removed from weapons, or exchanged by talking to Talvern in the Eggroost Observatory.

items.name: Blue Berry
items.lead: The Blue Berry is a common fruit obtained from Trees within the Forest alongside its counterpart the Red Berry, occasionally dropped from Tombs, destroyed Barrels, or from purchasing them from Pomme for 10 Gold each. It is a simple, juicy, round variant of a basic berry.

items.name: Diamond
fields:
• Blackened Cove
• The Eggroost
• Cobalt Cavern

• Ore Deposits
• Diamond Pebble
• Fishing (Cobalt Cavern)
items.lead: Diamond is a rare gemstone ore obtained from mining Ore Deposits in the Blackened Cove, completing a fishing quest, and The Eggroost. Diamonds stand out from other ores with its light blue color. An Iron Pickaxe or a Gemstone Pickaxe are required to mine the deposits from which Diamonds are obtained.

items.name: Emerald
fields:
• Desert of Foreboding Terror
• Desert Outpost
• Deep Desert
• Deep Desert Caverns
• Deadly Swamp
items.lead: The Emerald is a rare gemstone ore obtained occasionally from mining Ore Deposits in the Desert of Foreboding Terror, Deep Desert, Desert Outpost, and the Deadly Swamp. It can also be fished from Deep Desert Caverns' waters. It is a green gemstone that can be easily spotted on Ore Deposits by its distinct color.

items.name: Brass
items.lead: Brass is a material that can be obtained from Gorlan in the Desert Outpost by combining 2 Copper and 1 Zinc. It is a versatile brownish-yellow metal that is utilized in a wide range of crafting recipes throughout various stages of the game.

items.name: Arch Energy
items.lead: Arch Energy is a material obtained by Archmage at a 100% drop chance. It is a dark crimson powder containing magical energy. When used in Alchemy, it grants a 5% increase in Magic Damage and increases the Intellect stat by 4.

items.name: Chaos Essence
fields:
• Scarecrow
• Snow Cultist
• King Sandpod
• The Skeleton
• The Patris
• Mr. Normal
• N
• Old Fart
• Stray Oracle
• Lost Guys
• Jim
items.lead: Chaos Essence is a material that can be obtained by defeating various enemies such as the Scarecrow, Snow Cultist, King Sandpod, The Skeleton, The Patris, Mr. Normal, N, Stray Oracle, Old Fart, Lost Guys, and Jim. The Stray Oracle drops the least amount of chaos essence, while N drops the most. It appears to be a type of essence that is magenta.

items.name: Flounder
items.lead: Flounder is a rare fish that can be obtained by fishing at The Western Sea. Its primary usage is selling or fishing quests, as it lacks any usage in Alchemy.

items.name: Alga Trout
items.lead: The Alga Trout is a common drop from Fishing in The Western Sea and Pogo Path As their name suggests, Alga Trout are a species of fish that lives and swims in algae and moss so frequently that they are covered in it.

items.name: Arcane Essence
fields:
• Archmage
• Kai Guy
• Kai Lazurai
• Muk
• Purple Shark
items.lead: Arcane Essence is a material obtained from defeating Archmage, Kai Guy, Kai Lazurai, Purple Shark, and Muks. It appears to be a type of essence that is blue in color cyan. It is said to originate from creatures with potent magical abilities. Arcane Essence is used in various crafting recipes from various NPCs.

items.name: Iron Coin
items.lead: Iron Coins are a material and currency which can be obtained by completing The Big Iron's challenge. 15 Iron Coins will be given out upon completion, with additional Iron Coins for every surviving participant and every Point Bonuses. They can be used to purchase wares sold by the Odd Sculpture, or be sold for.

items.name: Foul Patch
items.lead: The Foul Patch is an material obtained from The Patris, which can be found lurking around Estascosas Isle. It is described as being "a rotten piece of cloth" which was dropped by The Patris. Its main use is to be an ingredient in the crafting recipe for the Patchwork, an exceedingly strong late-game armor sold by Betsy. Alternatively, it can be sold for 100 Gold, or given to Billy for his quests.

items.name: Gold Dust
fields:
• Vermeil Village
• Desert Outpost
• Blistering Quarry
• Mountain Outpost
• Cloud City
items.lead: Gold Dust is a material that can be purchased from Mela for. It appears to be an edible pile of gold powder. When used in Alchemy, it will create Gold Sludge, which gives (at base level). This effect increases gained from defeating enemies and increases ores gained from mining Ore Deposits. Keep in mind that the extra gold gained is only from killing enemies, and won't increase any other source of obtaining Gold.

items.name: Daedalus Chip
items.lead: The Daedalus Chip is a material dropped by the Daedalus Drone, which can be rarely found in the Deep Desert or The Eggroost. Its only uses are to craft the Copper Mech, or to give to Billy for his quests.

items.name: Green Teabag
fields:
• Vermeil Village
• Morning Hollow
• Silent Sanctuary

• Lumber Jack
• Treelad
• Grave Treelad
• Potcup
items.lead: The Green Teabag is an uncommon material that can be obtained from a Treelad drop within the first sections of the Morning Hollow. Alternatively, they can be purchased from Potcup for in a bundle of five. The Lumber Jack also gives one after you complete his quest. The Green Teabag appears to be a small sealed bag containing green leaves, it is described as a soothing and relaxing drink.

items.name: Coconut
fields:
• Big Bay
• Forest
• Enchanted Island
• Roberto's Island
A brief burst of speed and healing.
items.lead: Coconuts are an uncommon fruit material able to be harvested from Palm Trees in Big Bay, the Forest, and the Enchanted Island. They can additionally be purchased from Pomme for 20 Gold each. They are a round fruit encased within a tough brown shell. When brewed into a potion with a Cauldron, they can create Coconut Milk, a potion that instantly recovers some Health and grants the player the Swiftness Status Effect.

items.name: Choccy Bean
items.lead: Choccy Beans are a material obtained by hitting Trees in the Sinister Sea. When used in Alchemy, it creates Choco Cocoa, which is a good source of instant healing and speed.

items.name: Garden Jellyfish
fields:
• Isle of the Recital
• The Northern Sea
• Northern Labyrinth
items.lead: The Garden Jellyfish is a fish obtained by fishing in The Northern Sea. It is a small, pinkish, glowing, transparent jellyfish. They are most common at Isle of the Recital.

items.name: Coiled Hokra
items.lead: The Coiled Hokra is a rare fish found in the Isle of the Recital. It can be obtained from fishing in the waters within that island. It appears to be a long, thin, snake like fish curled into the shape of a spiral. It sells for 50 Gold. It also looks like the facial features of the Snow Husks.

items.name: Ice Arrow
items.lead: Ice Arrows are a material and an arrow that can be crafted by Fimbul at the Mountain Outpost to make a pack of 25. When used with most bows, it will make the bow inflict the chill status effect. It makes the Blizzard Greatbow shoot out icicles for increased damage. They can also be dropped by Hunters upon defeat. The arrows itself appears as a turquoise-colored arrow.

items.name: Glacial Spine
items.lead: The Glacial Spine is a material obtained from the Abdominal Snowman at a 100% chance. It is primarily used for giving to Ulf as part of the Mountain Myths quest, it can also be sold for.

items.name: Lemon
fields: Heals a decent chunk of your health, with some regeneration to back it up.

• Desert Outpost
• The Suslands
• Stonesurgeon
• Sweetberry Catacombs
items.lead: Lemons are uncommon fruits that can be obtained by harvesting them from Trees in the Desert Outpost, The Suslands, or Stonesurgeon. Alternatively, they can be purchased from Pomme for 20 Gold. They appear to be a standard yellow lemon with an oblong shape and two rounded ends. When used in Alchemy, they can be used to create Sour Juice.

items.name: Lilicod
items.lead: The Lilicod is a rare fish from fishing in the murky waters of the Deadly Swamp. It appears to be a dark green fish shaped like a lilypad, with a gaping mouth similar to that of an opening found on some lilypads. It also has a small tail.

items.name: Arctic Tuna
fields:
• The Northern Sea
• Wind Island
• Isle of the Recital
• Enchanted Island
items.lead: The Arctic Tuna is an uncommon fish found by Fishing within the icy waters of The Northern Sea. It appears to be a large, dark blue fish with two giant fins protruding from its sides. It currently has no use except for being able to be sold for 10 Gold.

items.name: Lime
fields: Heals a decent chunk of your mana,with some mana regeneration to help.
items.lead: Limes are a fruit obtained by harvesting from Trees in the Desert Outpost, The Suslands, or Stonesurgeon. They can also purchased from Pomme for 20 Gold. They appear to be a standard green lime with an oblong shape and rounded ends. When used in Alchemy, they can creates Bitter Juice, which instantly recovers some of the player's Mana in addition to granting Mana Regeneration.

items.name: Flare Arrow
items.lead: The Flare Arrow is a material and arrow obtained by purchasing it from Oglorn in the Blistering Quarry. The Flare Arrow inflicts the status effect, but deals less damage than the usual Arrow. It is crafted in packs of 10 by using 10 Fire Arrows, and 4 Magma Slime.

items.name: Explosive Arrow
items.lead: The Explosive Arrow is a material and arrow crafted by Kennit in the Stonesurgeon in groups of five for 10 Fire Arrows, and 1 Sulfur.

items.name: Fire Arrow
items.lead: The Fire Arrow is a Material and Arrow crafted by Oglorn in the Blistering Quarry in groups of 25 with 25 Arrows, 1 Demetal, and 1 Magma Slime. When shot from a bow at an enemy, it will deal damage and will inflict Fire. It can be used to craft the Explosive Arrow from Kennit, and the Flare Arrow from Oglorn.

items.name: Breakfast Teabag
items.lead: The Breakfast Teabag is an uncommon material that can be purchased from Potcup for 30 Gold in a bundle of five. The Breakfast Teabag appears to be a small sealed bag containing brown leaves, it is described as a soothing and relaxing drink. It can be boiled in a Cauldron to create Tea, a warm drink that can regenerate health and give swiftness. The stats are Heal 5% Max HP, Regeneration 0.6, Swiftness 0.6.

items.name: Gelatinous Sludge
items.lead: Gelatinous Sludge is a material that can be obtained by slaying Gluttos or by defeating Cata. This can be used to craft the Slime Hammer. It can also be used as a bait while fishing. It appears to be a shiny, dark-mahogany gel.

items.name: Broken Lever Piece
items.lead: The Broken Lever Piece is a rare material that can be obtained by searching Tombs inside of the prison of Sweetberry Catacombs. The Broken Lever Piece randomly spawns in one of the catacombs' Tombs every five minutes, with the specific Tomb having a sparkling effect. It appears to be a rusted piece of a lever.

items.name: Anglerfish
items.lead: The Anglerfish is a rare fish caught in the Cobalt Cavern and Deep Desert Caverns. They appear as a big brown fish that has a yellow glowing esca when fished up. They are used either for Jared's Fishing Quests, Quests, or Alchemy where they can be brewed into Glowing Potions, where it will inflict the Glowing Status Effect, making any entity with it glow a white bright light for the duration of the status effect.

items.name: Catfish
items.lead: Catfish is a fish that can be obtained by fishing at The Eastern Sea. It's uses now are both selling and offering to the Onyx Bowl.

items.name: Frozen Fish
fields:
• The Northern Sea
• Isle of the Recital
items.lead: The Frozen Fish is a uncommon fish that can be found in the Isle of the Recital, and as the name implies, the Frozen Fish is a fish, that is entirely coated in a sheet of blue ice. The most use the player will get from the fish will typically be for selling it for decent amounts of Gold and also from Fishing Quests.

items.name: Koi
fields:
• The Eastern Sea
• The Northern Sea
items.lead: Koi is a fish that can be fished up in The Eastern Sea and Northern Sea. It appears as a white fish with orange colors and whiskers. The only point the Koi serves as is to be sold for Gold or Jared's fishing quests.

items.name: Bud Carapace
items.lead: The Bud Carapace is a material that has a 25% chance to drop from killing Crystalbuds.

items.name: Iridescent Shard
items.lead: Iridescent Shard is a material obtained from defeating Crystalbuds and the Psychocrab. It appears to be a small pink shard. Iridescent shards can NOT be brewed in a cauldron.

items.name: Thief Trouble
fields:
• Bronze Greatsword
• Wooden Bow
• Magic Branch

• Kill 5 Thieves
• Return to Abraska
• Receive a gift from Abraska
• Investigate the King's Den
• Kill 1 Thief King
• Return to Abraska
items.lead: Thief Trouble is an early quest given by Abraska in Vermeil Village. After an infestation of Thieves has taken over the once peaceful Prairie. Abraska asks for assistance in taking out the crooks and discovering the source of the invasion. After you kill the five thieves, Abraska will give you a choice of a Bronze Greatsword, a Wooden Bow, or a Magic Branch. You can also decline this gift.

items.name: A Taste For Apple
items.lead: A Taste For Apple is an early quest granted by Lumber Jack in Vermeil Village. To get the player to bask in the joys of nature with him, Lumber Jack requests the player to harvest 20 Apples from the nearby trees, which can be obtained by attacking trees with any melee weapon. Giving the 20 apples to Lumber Jack awards, 100 XP, and 1 Breakfast Teabag.

items.name: A Family Feud
items.lead: A Family Feud is a quest given by Nebraska in the Desert of Foreboding Terror that rewards the Butler armor, granting the player reduced fall damage and increased speed. After being informed that his sister Lebrony in Vermeil Village is spreading lies about him being an annoying brother despite being separated at birth, Nebraska asserts that Lebrony is a liar.

items.name: Road to RockStardom
fields:
• Kill 10 Frost Assassins
• Kill 5 Ice Golems
• Kill 5 Hunters
• Kill 5 Bushwalkers
• Meet The Duke of Rocks at the Peak of the Mountain
items.lead: Road to RockStardom is a quest given by The Duke of Rocks. It rewards the ancient Rockwondo fighting style, a close-combat medium melee weapon. When the player talks to The Duke of Rocks about being a “RockStar”, The Duke of Rocks sends them on a journey to the Cold Trail, which transitions to The Snow Highlands, defeating various enemies to prove that they are a “RockStar”.

items.name: First Impressions
items.lead: First Impressions is the first quest the player can accept upon loading in for the first time from Skeleton O'Myers in Dead Man's Grotto.

items.name: Thief World Tour
items.lead: Thief World Tour is a quest given by Vigilante. The quest starts when Vigilante tasks the player to go on a world tour and slay thieves, after the player mentions that they look like an "evil thief". Completing this quest will grant the Thief armor as a reward from Vigilante.

items.name: Innocuous Induction
items.lead: Innocuous Induction is a quest initiated by Rafaes in the Sinister Sea and is required in order to join the Chaos Cultists Guild and access the Chaos Hideout and the N boss. In order to prove themselves and their dedication to joining the Chaos Cultists, Rafaes requests the player retrieve a Normal Claw and 100 Chaos Essence for him.

items.name: Mountain Myths
items.lead: Mountain Myths is a quest given by Ulf in the Mountain Outpost, he's sitting near a tree at the northern-west of the fireplace. In the quest, he tells you to help him get 1 Glacial Spine from Abdominal Snowman. When you finished the quest, he will give you a huge amount of money, from which is all of his savings.

items.name: To Sling A Shot
items.lead: To Sling A Shot is a quest given by Adagio in the Cloud City. He is located on an island at the back of William's house. This quest is needed to get onto Cloud Wilds. In the quest, you need to pass 30 waves of Sky Battlegrounds in order to use the slingshot.

items.name: Seaside Skirmish
items.lead: Seaside Skirmish is an early game quest given to the player by Humblert. He claims that everyone left the beach because of the attacking pirates. If the player agrees to help with the pirate problem Humblert will thank them and state that Pop Off Pirate is most likely responsible.

items.name: Swamp Sojourn
items.lead: Swamp Sojourn is an early game quest given to the player by Captorio. When the player first interacts with Captorio he is seen talking to himself, inquiring on how someone would enter the swamp. When asking him what's in the swamp, Captorio will respond that there are rare ingredients. However, it is highly dangerous to enter the swamp.

items.name: The Outlaw Torn
fields:
• Desert of Foreboding Terror
• Temple of Foreboding Terror
items.lead: The Outlaw Torn is a early-mid game quest given to the player initially by an unknown person behind a locked door. Once you complete the quest, Farlami is revealed to have been that unknown person. When the player enters the desert for the first time a cutscene will play, showing a closed door in one of the rock formations. When the player goes to interact with the door a voice can be heard from the other side.

items.name: My Archenemy
items.lead: My Archenemy is a mid-game quest given to the player by Skeleton O'Fun. Skeleton O'Fun is located in the Mountain Basin which is east of Mondo Squid over the mountainside. Skeleton O'Fun states that their friend betrayed them, destroyed their village, and fled to the magic island. Skeleton O'Fun then offers to pay the player if they can kill the Archmage.

items.name: Elite Training
items.lead: Elite Training is a mid-game quest given to the player by Trinks. When the player first enters Stonesurgeon and gets nearby the giant tree in the middle, a cutscene will play showing Trinks yelling at the player to come talk to him. When the player interacts with Trinks he'll inform them that he was sent to Stonesurgeon to defend; however, someone threw a rock at him and now he's unable.

items.name: Order Up
items.lead: Order Up is a quest given to the player by Verdant in the Stonesurgeon after the player has defeated Viperhead.

items.name: Find the Jewelry
items.lead: Find the Jewelry was a quest initiated by Gale in Isle of the Recital that grants the player permanent access to The Winter when completed. Upon striking a deal with Gale in order to know more about Gale and his people, Gale will task the player with finding a missing necklace he valued greatly.

items.name: Sinister Scourge
items.lead: Sinister Scourge is a quest given by Kyle in Elite Barracks, after accepting Secrets of Cobalt from him and then speaking to Taurus(Journeyman in Elite Knights Guild required), while also having the Elite Training quest completed. You also need to have killed Highway Son. He is located on the table nearest to the entrance.

items.name: Bounty Hunter
fields: Special Fishing Chest (higher gold reward and higher chance for items.)
items.lead: Bounty Hunter is a repeatable quest that can be obtained by Scampi in the Sinister Sea. He will give you a random boss near or in the area of the Sinister Sea to kill and come back for a reward.

items.name: Hardy Hardware
items.lead: Hardy Hardware is a quest that can be obtained by talking to Limo at Forgotten Village. The quest requires the player to retrieve the lost toolbox for Limo in a section of the Morning Hollow. After returning this toolbox obtained from Fran, a wanderer who stumbled upon the toolbox, the player will be rewarded for a Lantern, and 1000 XP.

items.name: Eggy Antics
items.lead: Eggy Antics is a quest given by Marometro at the Eggroost Observatory, Marometro will ask the player about the Eggies for research due to his curiosity of the creatures. The quest serves to be a basic and simple quest for late to end-game players to get a decent amount of gold and get to most of the time level 30.

items.name: Seed
items.lead: The Seed is an interactable object located in the Sweetberry Catacombs. These are use for Senior's quest, and his quest is to find 10 Seeds scattered throughout the catacombs. When interacted with, the Seeds will make a sound, and the light it was giving off would disappear. The seed then becomes translucent.

items.name: Fishing Quest
items.lead: Fishing Quests are a mechanic added in The Raindrops. Fishing Quests are given by Jared and allow players to complete quests by providing fish for rewards, including Gold, Ores, and Gems. After completing every five Fishing Quests, a special dialogue will appear, allowing the player to choose one of three random rewards offered by Jared. Rod of Kings will be awarded every 20 quests.

items.name: Down In Flames
fields:
• 250 Gold
• 2000 EXP
• Player’s choice of either 250 Gold, x12 Demetal, or x3 Rubies
• Mining Helmet
items.lead: Down In Flames is a quest that can be given by either Bert, a banker in the Blistering Quarry, or Paul, a miner inside of a jail cell that can be accessed from the Cruel Caverns. All variations of the quest will lead to Bert giving the player a reward of their choice, and a Mining Helmet upon completion. It will also allow the player to trade with Miner.

items.name: Humble Beginings
items.lead: Humble Beginings is a quest during the April Fools Event 2024, given by Roberto. It grants the player one of the five keys necessary to complete the event, the Roberto Key, upon completion. Listening to Roberto's problems and offering to help him will task the player with defeating 10 Ruffians, the bandits which have lived on Roberto's Island without paying taxes to him.

items.name: Chaotic Curiosity
items.lead: The Chaotic Curiosity is a quest initiated by Wess at the Chaos Hideout, after visiting 3 rifts of any kind and holding out the Chaos Recorder until it shines Wess gives you the entropy needle which allows you to visit rifts.

items.name: Clash of Faiths
items.lead: Clash of Faiths is a quest you receive from Gale in the Isle of the Recital. To start the quest, the player must kill the False Believer in the Winter and return to Gale in the Isle of the Recital. Afterwards, you will need to find False Believer's bell in the Winter. His bell is located on a low cliff west of the palace housing the Snow Cultist.

items.name: Pictures On My Mind
items.lead: Pictures On My Mind is a quest given out by Bailiff. It involves taking eleven different pictures using a Magic Clipboard on locations given out by Bailiff himself. When a player is using the Magic Clipboard and clicks, several sparks will spew out in the direction where you need to take a picture at.

items.name: Mr Smith
items.lead: Mr Smith is a Quest Given by Vergil in Vermeil Village. The quest is given when initiating a conversation with him, where he tasks the player to collect ores for him.

items.name: Scholar of the Serpent
items.lead: Scholar of the Serpent is a quest given by Boyle in the Desert of Foreboding Terror near Nebraska's shop.

items.name: Unconventional Weapons
items.lead: Unconventional Weapons is a quest given by Boyle in the Cloud City after completing the Scholar of the Serpent quest.

items.name: Resonant Research
items.lead: Resonant Research is a quest given by Boyle in the Cloud Wilds after completing the Unconventional Weapons quest.

items.name: The Sandstone Throne
items.lead: The Sandstone Throne is a quest given by Boyle it the Eggroost Observatory after the player has completed the Resonant Research quest.

items.name: Elite Operations
fields:
• Gold (depends on bounty)
• XP (depends on bounty)
• Guild XP (depends on bounty/Guild Level)
items.lead: Elite Operations is a quest given by Kyle, at the Elite Barracks, it consist on kill an especific amount of enemies from an area, depending on the bounty, the reward incrase or decrase.

items.name: One Last Time
items.lead: One Last Time is a quest given by a Stray in The Winter. The Stray is located behind a rock beside a destroyed house, below the cliffs of the Frozen Cathedral.

items.name: Armory Assessment
items.lead: Armory Assessment is a repeatable quest given by Talvern in the Eggroost Observatory.

items.name: Sticky Situation
items.lead: Sticky Situation is a quest given by Archer in Vermeil Village, where the player is tasked with investigating Björn Cave. Once the cave has been investigated, Archer will tell you to kill Yalgaroth, the slime boss, at the back of the cave. Upon returning to Archer, he will reward the player with 25x Slime Arrow, Gold, and XP.

items.name: Secrets of Cobalt
items.lead: Secrets of Cobalt is a questline given by Taurus (who will initially be located on an island right off the shore near the Elite Barracks) after speaking to Kyle (which also includes completing other quests that he prompts you with first). The main objective of the quest is to slay Purple Shark with the help of Taurus, while the rest of the objectives are centered around unlocking the seal to Purple Shark and…

items.name: Eyes That Sea
items.lead: Eyes That Sea is one of the two questlines related to the Cobalt Caverns, the other being Secrets of Cobalt.

items.name: Hunting Hunters
items.lead: Hunting Hunters is a quest given by The Real Hunter in The Snow Highlands.

items.name: Set Sail
items.lead: Set Sail is a quest given by the Dock when the player interacts with it for the first time, prompting them to buy a Sailboat from Sailord for 500 Gold.

items.name: Robot Rock
items.lead: - Kill 5 Icarus Drones or Daedalus Drones

items.name: Booksmart
items.lead: - Search the Cathedral of Mt. St. Rhubarb for books on the Highway
